sonnet.problem: The story card right before it quotes the verse as a rhetorical question, 'who, O Lord, could stand?', and the choice card asks the same fact about the same verse. The question already tells the baker that no one could stand, so nothing is left to work out.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The setup says the watchmen are 'up all night in the dark, waiting for one thing'. That gives away 'morning' for the fill-in-the-blank on the next card. It also adds a night-in-the-dark setting that the verse does not state.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
